edits.after: Your guaranteed W-Q knockup beats Braum, who needs stacks from his ADC to trigger the stun.

edits.after: Your flip dictates every engage here — Braum only has Winter's Bite and E to react with.

edits.before: Zone with combo threat — their carry farms at the range your W defines.
edits.after: You keep initiative through 4-5, punishing every Concussive Blows stack attempt.

edits.before: Unbreakable Will online — tower dives become appointments; the cow ignores the counter-CC.
edits.after: Your unstoppable R beats his one-directional Unbreakable — flip the carry off its facing.

edits.before: First item: the front line holds and the combos chain into jungler arrivals.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.

edits.before: - Braum Unbreakable: matchup-defining — The shield wall eats your poke and engage projectiles — wait it out. It writes your spacing rules. - R Unbreakable Will is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: You start the fights your team finishes — chain the carry, peel the counter, hold the line.
edits.after: Q and E ground his W leap to an ally — hold one for the engage, not the poke, and shut the peel down.
